title: Pacific Mall Delhi - Shopping, Food Court, Timings & Travel Guide
content:
Pacific Mall - Delhi,

Pacific Mall in Subhash Nagar is one of the most popular shopping malls in Delhi, offering a perfect blend of shopping, dining, and entertainment. With over 300 national and international brands, a multi-cuisine food court, and a modern multiplex, it’s a complete package for families, couples, and youngsters. Whether you’re here for shopping, catching the latest movie, or just spending a relaxed evening, Pacific Mall has something for everyone.

Shopping Experience:

Pacific Mall is a shopper’s paradise. From luxury brands to affordable fashion, it covers all shopping needs. Popular brands like H&M, Zara, Marks & Spencer, Sephora, and Lifestyle make it a go-to spot for fashion lovers. Apart from clothing, you’ll also find electronics, footwear, cosmetics, and home decor stores.

Food & Dining:

The food court and restaurants at Pacific Mall are a major attraction. The food court offers a wide variety of cuisines – from Indian street food to international fast food chains. Popular eateries include Domino’s, Burger King, KFC, Biryani Blues, and Haldiram’s. For fine dining, visitors can head to Punjab Grill, Chili’s, and Jamie’s Pizzeria.

Entertainment & Activities:

  • PVR Cinemas for the latest movies.
  • Fun City Play Zone for kids.
  • VR experiences & gaming arcades for youngsters.
  • Regular events, exhibitions, and live shows in the mall atrium.

Entry Fee & Timings:

  • Entry Fee: Free
  • Timings: 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM (All Days)

How to Reach:

  • Nearest Metro Station: Subhash Nagar Metro Station (Blue Line) – walking distance.
  • By Road: Well-connected via Ring Road and Najafgarh Road, cabs and autos easily available.
  • Parking: Multi-level parking available for both cars and two-wheelers.

Places to Visit Nearby:

  • Rajouri Garden Markets.
  • TDI Mall.
  • Janakpuri District Centre.
  • Karol Bagh Market.

Travel Tips:

  • Visit early on weekends to avoid heavy crowds.
  • Take advantage of seasonal sales for the best deals.
  • Metro is the most convenient way to reach, as traffic can be heavy.
excerpt: Pacific Mall, Subhash Nagar is one of the most loved shopping and entertainment hubs in Delhi. With global fashion brands, multiplex, gaming zones, and a wide food variety, it’s a perfect spot for shopping, family outings, and weekend fun. Its easy metro connectivity makes it even more accessible for visitors.
